output: Scored this adorable Y2K baby tee with the cutest butterfly print on Depop for just $18, and I’m so obsessed. Just scored this vintage light wash cropped denim jacket on Poshmark for only $42 and I'm obsessed. I can't wait to style it with a white tank and baggy dark wash jeans for the ultimate casual streetwear vibe. It's definitely going to be on heavy rotation!

Scored these chunky platform sneakers on Poshmark for just $48 and I am obsessed. They are bringing all the Y2K off-duty energy when I style them with a ribbed tank, baggy dark wash jeans, and a cropped hoodie. Honestly the ultimate streetwear find for my wardrobe rotation.

Scored this butterfly print Y2K baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I am obsessed. I’m living for the soft contrast of styling it with wide-leg khaki trousers and combat boots. It’s officially my new go-to piece for every aesthetic.

Just scored these low-rise khaki cargo pants on Poshmark for only $27 and I am officially living my 2000s pop star dream. I'm obsessed with styling them as a Y2K streetwear look with a cropped zip hoodie and chunky sneakers for that ultimate effortless edge. Can't wait to wear this vibe on repeat all season!
